senses.gloss: ch. (cmp. b. h. בָּלַל) to mix, knead; trnsf. (cmp. גרס, דרש) to study thoroughly.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 65a:3">Men. 65ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>בלשן</he>, <cite ref="Nehemiah 7:7">Neh. VII, 7</cite>; cmp. <he>בלשׁ</he>) <he>הוה בָּיֵיל … ודריש</he> he studied languages and explained them.

senses.gloss: same; trnsf. to discuss. Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵃ מאן דתני אוֹבִיל נייבל (read נְבַיֵּיל) he who reads in the Mish. (III, 5; v. בִּין Hif.) obil, means, Let us discuss the subject.
